criteria.name: Design
criteria.proof: English three-stage flow; recorded execution labelled explicitly; proposal changes clear prior results; browser-only review form
criteria.remaining: Complete desktop/mobile final review and two independent developer sessions; fix observed blockers

criteria.name: Potential Impact
criteria.proof: Specific developer and accessibility-QA audience; original booking blockage and preserved expected business outcome
criteria.remaining: Collect two real browser-only usefulness/comprehension observations; report sample size and limits without inventing time saved or adoption

criteria.name: Quality of the Idea
criteria.proof: Outcome acceptance follows the task into storage and a fresh session; a plausible patch and keyboard success can still fail regression checks
criteria.remaining: Show one failure and one verified result clearly in the final demo and description
